records.question: Four cats live in the old grey house at the end of the road.  Their names are Puffy, Scruffy, Buffy, and Juniper.  Puffy has three times more whiskers than Juniper, but half as many as Scruffy.  Buffy has the same number of whiskers as the average number of whiskers on the three other cats.  If Juniper has 12 whiskers. how many whiskers does Buffy have?
records.response:
If Juniper has 12 whiskers, then Puffy has 3*12 = 36 whiskers.
If Puffy has 36 whiskers, then Scruffy has 2*36 = 72 whiskers.
The average number of whiskers on the three other cats is (36+12+72)/3 = 120/3 = 40.
Buffy has the same number of whiskers as the average number of whiskers on the three other cats, so she has 40 whiskers.
#### 40

records.question: David swims the 100-meter freestyle in 48 seconds.  He swims the 100-meter backstroke 4 seconds slower than he swims the 100-meter freestyle, he swims the 100-meter butterfly 3 seconds slower than he swims the 100-meter backstroke, and he swims the 100-meter breaststroke 2 seconds slower than he swims the 100-meter butterfly.  What is the combined length of time, in seconds, it would take for him to swim all four 100-meter events (the freestyle, the backstroke, the butterfly, and the breaststroke)?
records.response:
The backstroke is 48 + 4 = 52 seconds.
The butterfly is 52 + 3 = 55 seconds.
The breaststroke is 55 + 2 = 57 seconds.
It takes 48 + 52 + 55 + 57 = 212 seconds to swim all four events.
#### 212
